panels.title: Air Quality Index (EPA, PM2.5/PM10)
panels.description: The real US EPA AQI (Table 6, document.airnow.gov, current as of the May 2024 PM2.5 revision) -- not a heuristic. GREATEST of the PM2.5 and PM10 sub-indices, matching EPA's own "report the worst pollutant" methodology; whichever of the two has no data is ignored, not treated as zero. PM1.0/PM4.0 have no EPA breakpoints, so they're not folded in here -- see their own concentration gauges below. Blank on a probe with no SPS30 (e.g. BME680-only) -- see the Gas Resistance panel for that case instead; probes/aqi.py's compute_overall_air_quality_index is the source of truth this mirrors.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_pm25 AS (
  SELECT r.value AS pm25 FROM telemetry_sensorreading r
  WHERE r.sensor_type = 'sps30_pm2_5_ug_m3' ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 1
),
latest_pm10 AS (
  SELECT r.value AS pm10 FROM telemetry_sensorreading r
  WHERE r.sensor_type = 'sps30_pm10_ug_m3' ORDER BY r.time DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT GREATEST(
  (SELECT CASE
    WHEN pm25 IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN pm25 <= 9.0   THEN round(((50.0-0.0)/(9.0-0.0)) * (pm25-0.0) + 0)
    WHEN pm25 <= 35.4  THEN round(((100.0-51.0)/(35.4-9.1)) * (pm25-9.1) + 51)
    WHEN pm25 <= 55.4  THEN round(((150.0-101.0)/(55.4-35.5)) * (pm25-35.5) + 101)
    WHEN pm25 <= 125.4 THEN round(((200.0-151.0)/(125.4-55.5)) * (pm25-55.5) + 151)
    WHEN pm25 <= 225.4 THEN round(((300.0-201.0)/(225.4-125.5)) * (pm25-125.5) + 201)
    ELSE round(((500.0-301.0)/(325.4-225.5)) * (pm25-225.5) + 301)
  END FROM latest_pm25),
  (SELECT CASE
    WHEN pm10 IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN pm10 <= 54  THEN round(((50.0-0.0)/(54.0-0.0)) * (pm10-0.0) + 0)
    WHEN pm10 <= 154 THEN round(((100.0-51.0)/(154.0-55.0)) * (pm10-55.0) + 51)
    WHEN pm10 <= 254 THEN round(((150.0-101.0)/(254.0-155.0)) * (pm10-155.0) + 101)
    WHEN pm10 <= 354 THEN round(((200.0-151.0)/(354.0-255.0)) * (pm10-255.0) + 151)
    WHEN pm10 <= 424 THEN round(((300.0-201.0)/(424.0-355.0)) * (pm10-355.0) + 201)
    ELSE round(((500.0-301.0)/(604.0-425.0)) * (pm10-425.0) + 301)
  END FROM latest_pm10)
) AS "Air Quality Index";

panels.title: Power Health (Raspberry Pi undervoltage)
panels.description: From `vcgencmd get_throttled` on each probe (weathernet_probe/health.py). 'now' is the instant of the last report; 'occurred' is sticky since that probe's last reboot, so it also catches a brief brownout (e.g. a sensor's fan inrush current) between two reporting cycles that 'now' would likely miss. Null on non-Pi hardware or if vcgencmd isn't available. No alert rule is provisioned -- add one manually in Grafana pointed at this panel's query if you want a notification, not just a place to look during troubleshooting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name, h.undervoltage_now, h.undervoltage_occurred, h.time AS last_health_at FROM telemetry_probehealth h JOIN probes_probe p ON p.id = h.probe_id ORDER BY p.id, h.time DESC;
